sentences.text: As per the prosecution case, the petitioner and the co-accused persons are alleged to have committed murder of the daughter of the informant for the non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case.
The petitioners have no criminal antecedent as stated in para 3 of the bail petition.
There is a delay of more than three months in lodging the F.I.R from the date of alleged occurrence.

Learned counsel has further submitted that the husband of the deceased has already been murdered by the informant party of this case for which a case has been lodged in P.S Case No.
53 of 2021 in connection with Balua Bazar.
It is further submitted that the petitioner No. 1 is full brother and other petitioners are family members of petitioner No. 1.
6. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer of anticipatory bail of the petitioners.

7. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioners, in the event of their Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.72447 of 2023(2) dt.10-11-2023 arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court concerned, Supaul in connection with Balua Bazar P.S. Case No. 11 of 2022, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Chandra Prakash Singh, J) atul/-
